title: Materials.
officialText: Pipe and steel cores shall conform to the material requirements in Section 1809.3. Pipes shall have a minimum wall thickness of ⅜ inch (9.5 mm) and shall be fitted with a suitable steel-driving shoe or cutting teeth welded to the bottom of the pipe. Concrete or grout shall have a 28-day specified compressive strength (f'c) of not less than 4,000 psi (27.58 MPa).
